menFootwear.title: Men's Footwear Conversion Chart
menFootwear.description: Standard UK, US Men, EU, and foot length (CM) conversion table for athletic and casual footwear.
menFootwear.measuringTip: Stand barefoot on a piece of paper with your heel against a flat wall. Mark the longest point of your toe and measure the distance in centimeters.

womenFootwear.title: Women's Footwear Conversion Chart
womenFootwear.description: UK, US Women, EU, and CM conversion for women's lifestyle and running footwear.
womenFootwear.measuringTip: If you have wider feet or prefer extra room in running footwear, consider going up by half a UK size.

unisexFootwear.title: Unisex & Heritage Footwear Conversion Chart
unisexFootwear.description: Universal cross-gender sizing for iconic sneaker silhouettes.
unisexFootwear.measuringTip: Unisex shoes are based on standard Men's UK sizing. Women should subtract 1.5 to 2 from their usual US Women size.

menClothing.title: Men's Apparel Size Guide
menClothing.description: Body measurements in inches for men's t-shirts, polos, shirts, and outerwear.
menClothing.measuringTip: Chest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping tape horizontal. Waist: Measure around natural waistline.

womenClothing.title: Women's Apparel Size Guide
womenClothing.description: Body measurements in inches for women's tees, tops, and casual apparel.
womenClothing.measuringTip: Bust: Measure fullest part under armpits. Hips: Measure around fullest point of hips/seat.
